strategy.overview: Wood's Queen advances the six-bank through a 5,000 award, a 10,000 award that lights Special, and a third completion that collects Special. The other route completes the seven standups and then shoots the lit red target. Use whichever target group gives the safer rebounds.
strategy.summary: Clear the six drop targets three times: the first clear scores a 5,000 target bonus, the second scores 10,000 and lights Special, and the third collects Special.

quickInfo.name: Drop targets
quickInfo.summary: Complete the bank once for a 5,000 target bonus. Complete it again for 10,000 and to light Special, then complete it a third time to collect Special.

quickInfo.name: Stand-up targets
quickInfo.summary: Hit all seven stand-up targets to light their white lamps, then hit the red-lit target to collect Special.

quickInfo.name: Special
quickInfo.summary: A lit Special turns off when the ball leaves the playfield; before tournament play, confirm what Special awards on that setup.

steps.text: Complete the six drop targets once to score a 5,000 target bonus.
Complete the drop targets again to score 10,000 and light Special.
Complete the drop targets a third time to collect Special before the ball drains.

alternatives.title: Stand-up-target Special
alternatives.when: Use this as the alternative Special route.

steps.text: Hit all seven stand-up targets to light their white lamps.
Hit the red-lit target to collect Special before the ball drains.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm what a lit Special awards on the tournament setup.
Test the six-bank reset, stand-up-target lamps, red-lit target, and Special lamp.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Wood's Queen, three completions of the six-bank advance through 5,000, 10,000, and Special. Completing the seven standup targets lights Special at a red target. Use whichever target group gives the safer rebounds.
machineSetup: Confirm what a lit Special awards on the tournament setup.
